column3: Close to the Hebrew; “it has awakened against you” is rendered “It has dawned for you.”
The meaning of the Hebrew word rendered “Doom” is uncertain; the last line (“not shouting on the mountains”) is rendered “not of rejoicing.”
Close to the Hebrew; the uncertain word is again rendered “Doom.”
The end of the verse is obscure in Hebrew; the meaning is uncertain. NKJV reads the last word as “wailing.”
The Hebrew is difficult; the meaning is uncertain. NKJV reads “He set it in majesty,” where the Hebrew may mean “they turned it into pride.”
